rejection_reasons: There is no single central event corroborated by at least two different publisher domains. The supplied records cover unrelated developments (one about an ex-IYC president defending a pipeline surveillance contract from thereporter.com.ng, and others from punchng.com covering separate calls for President Tinubu's re-election by an NDDC director and the Ekiti State governor).

None of the distinct publisher domains materially corroborate the same central event. The story regarding Atiku's proposal on petrol prices appears only on a single domain (thereporter.com.ng), while the remaining reports cover separate, unrelated political statements.

Insufficient cross-publisher corroboration. The records describe two separate developments (Governor Biodun Oyebanji addressing Muslims regarding President Bola Tinubu's re-election from punchng.com, and Atiku Abubakar urging petrol price reductions from thereporter.com.ng). Neither central event is corroborated by at least two independent publisher domains.
